Movement- Snarky's List

Note!
Snarky's List now includes -% Movement. Watch for this! Do NOT blindly copy stats blindly as the information will be wrong!Reference a screen capture of the RB stats or from the game to be sure! Do not include -% Movement or +% Movement unless it is abnormal. See Fighter Armor, Ranger Armor Mage Armor for what is considered "normal" movement for that particular piece.
For instance-
Ma'nes Scapulae has exceptional movement in the neighborhood of +12%... Where as normally, ghost armor (see Mage Armor has movement +3%, a + % Movement Speed should be added to the Ma'nes Scapulae attributes.
For instance-
Chavez's Shoulders of Shattering some varieties have + % Movement speed. Normally, Military Splint Shoulders (see Ranger Armor has a - 1% movement speed, a + % Movement Speed should be added to the [[[Chavez's Shoulders of Shattering]] attributes.
For instance-
Brilliance on Snarky's shows - % Movement speed, in game this is -3% Movement Speed in Red. Normally, Sunstone Helm (see Fighter Armor has a - 3% movement speed, a - % Movement Speed should NOT be added to the Brilliance attributes.
For instance-
Zippy items have additional speed over and above what is normal... ALL Leather helms have a +1% Movement, Zippy leather helms have additional speed over and above +1% movement.
